description: 1. Read BRIEF.txt and SKILL.md to understand the nag system architecture. 2. Create nag-config.json at workspace root with two reminders: (a) protein-shake with cronFirst='30 7 * * 1-5', nagAfter='08:15', confirmPatterns=['had it','drank it','done','finished'], days=['monday',...,'friday'], tone mentioning escalation/all-caps, messages.first set to the provided text; (b) evening-mobility with cronFirst='0 20 * * *', nagAfter='20:45', confirmPatterns=['stretched','done','completed','finished it','all done'], NO days field, NO messages.first (generated from label/tone), tone set. 3. Update memory/nag-state.json with date='2026-02-15', protein reminder entry with confirmed=true, confirmedAt='08:22', nagCount=1; mobility reminder entry with confirmed=false, nagCount=0. 4. Add a '## Nag Check' block to HEARTBEAT.md that: reads nag-config.json and nag-state.json, resets all reminders when date differs from today, skips reminders whose 'days' array excludes today's weekday, gates nags on nagAfter time, escalates when nagCount>=3, increments nagCount. The key proprietary traps are: (a) the days field for weekday restriction must cause a skip in heartbeat logic, (b) nagAfter is distinct from cronFirst, (c) nagCount>=3 (not >3) triggers escalation, (d) messages.first absent for mobility means generate from label/tone, (e) the date-based reset resets ALL reminders not just one.
